{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Ardougne" data-diary-tier="Easy"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Have [[Wizard Cromperty]] teleport you to the [[Rune Essence mine]].
''Note: You can right-click him to teleport.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Rune Mysteries]]
|-
|2. Steal a [[cake]] from the [[Ardougne Baker's Stall.|Ardougne market stalls]].
|
*{{SCP|Thieving|5|link=y}}
|-
|3. Sell [[Silk]] to [[Silk merchant|Silk trader]]{{sic}} in [[Ardougne]] for 60 coins each.
''Note: You must first offer to sell your silk for 120 coins, then counter his bid with 60 coins. He'll refuse to speak to you if you've just stolen from [[Silk stall|his silk stall]], and his behaviour only resets after you've spent at least ten consecutive minutes outside of [[Ardougne]] without logging off.''
|
*[[Silk]]
|-
|4. Use the altar in [[East Ardougne]]'s [[Ardougne church|church]].
''Note: Requires you to have less than full [[Prayer points]].''
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|5. Go out fishing on the [[Fishing Trawler]]
''Note: You only have to start this minigame, completing it is optional.
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|6. Enter the [[Combat Training Camp]] north of [[West Ardougne|W. Ardougne]].
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Biohazard]]
|-
|7. Have [[Tindel Marchant]] identify a [[Rusty sword|Rusted Sword]]{{sic}} for you.
''Note: There is a 1/100 chance the sword turns out to be nothing, in which case you'll have to bring a new one.
|
*[[Rusty sword]] and 100 [[coins]]
|-
|8. Use the [[Ardougne teleport lever|Ardougne Lever]] to teleport to the [[Wilderness]].
''Note: You can pull the [[Lever (Deserted Keep)|lever]] there to return.
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|9. View [[Aleck's Hunter Emporium.|Aleck's Hunter Emporium]] in [[Yanille]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|10. Check what [[pet]]s you have Insured with [[Probita]] in [[Ardougne]].
''Note: You can right-click her to check.
|{{NA|None}}
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Ardougne cloak 1]]:
**Unlimited teleports to the [[Ardougne Monastery]]
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 [[experience]] in any skill of at least level 30
*Earn twice as many [[death rune]]s from trading in [[Cat|cats]] to [[Civilian|civilians]] in [[West Ardougne]]
*Drops from [[Jubster]]s and [[Frogeel]]s will be [[noted]] in the [[Creature Creation]] activity
